-- O amount_paid de R$ 909,80 e status 'partial' permanecem corretos

SET payment_links = NULL
WHERE id = 57;

-- Verificar resultado
SELECT id, value, amount_paid, status, payment_links FROM subscription_charges WHERE id = 57;
